body:
I took my normal dose of ephedra 25mg to get me going in the morning so I could work on some stuff. I then packed a bowl of homemade spice mixture with JWH-122 topped with some kava kava. The kava kava powder on top burned weird and gave the smoke a weird taste. Wasn't good but not unbearable.
I was already feeling the effects of the ephedra about 40 mins after taking it. Thats when I decided it would be good to smoke. The high was different from the normal jwh. It def brought out more euphoria from the ephedra. I feel the body buzz of bud but I'm wide awake and alert. I don't know if the kava kava really did anything at all it kinda seems like a bullshit herb it to me. I've made teas, smoked it and nothing really happens besides a little mood lift.
An hour later and I'm still feeling both effects and they are working nicely together. Normally I would be really tired and just wanna lay in bed but I am able to get stuff done.
